title: PartnerDatasetRpt
description: Metadata for a Dataset. A Dataset is a batch of data that contributes to a Data Product. The Dataset may be downloaded as a formatted Report via this API, or via BigQuery depending on Dataset Type.

dataProductVersion.description: Id of the specific version of the data product template used.

dataProductCode.description: The data product code, this may be contributed to by several template versions over time.

orderDate.description: The System Date for the dataset creation.

datasetType.description: Classification of the dataset. PARQUET sets can be formatted and downloaded on demand. BIGQUERY can not be downloaded, only accessed via BigQuery. LEGACY reports (CSV, XLSX) are preformatted.

datasetName.description: Userfriendly name of the dataset, typically used as the filename when downloaded.

status.description: Current status of the dataset: 0=Ordered, 1=COMPLETED, 2=Failed, 4=On Demand (DEPRECATED), 3=Cancelled, 9=Processing.

rows.description: Number of rows in the dataset when COMPLETED. Not available for legacy reports.

bqProject.description: Destination BigQuery project when dataset is of type BIGQUERY.

chartOfAccountsRef.description: The Chart of Accounts this dataset is derived from, if defined.

ownerOrgRef.description: Organisation owning the dataset with self-service access.

copyOrgRefs.description: Recipients of the dataset with self-service and M2M access.

acctMonthId.description: Clearing system Accounting Month ID used by this dataset.

glBatchId.description: GL Batch ID potentially used by this dataset.

apBatchId.description: AP Batch ID potentially used by this dataset.

arBatchId.description: AR Batch ID potentially used by this dataset.

inBatchId.description: IN Batch ID potentially used by this dataset.

agreementId.description: Clearing system Agreement ID potentially used by this dataset.
